content: C2PA / Content Credentials provenance model: a manifest records assertions (statements about an asset: origin=when/where/who, actions=what edits with what tools, ingredients=source assets used, AI-use disclosure). Claims aggregate assertions and link to ingredient manifests; signatures bind claims to signer; hard bindings = content hashes detect tampering. For internal-only doc provenance (no public disclaimer needed) the useful borrowed concepts are: per-unit record of model/version/effort, tooling version, source/ingredient origins (which files/PRs were read), action history (drafted/edited), and reviewer edits - stored as structured fields, not embedded crypto signatures.
